[spoiler=[b]The Great Jihad - Part 2[/b]
[i]When power is pursued in the name of faith, the lines blur between the righteous and the ruthless[/i]]
After the events of the previous day, no soldier had dared to so much as breathe too close to the commander. Tension hung in the air and followed the unit wherever they went. Things were going normally, or as normal as things could go in the Sal-Baliz, until they heard a sound overhead. Immediately the soldiers dropped to the ground as they had been trained to, without even requiring an order from Abd. The noise soon dissipated and the soldiers looked up to the sky. They were expecting a bird, or a passenger plane, or even a drone, but no one was expecting to see the shape that loomed in the distance. A Hydronian military helicopter. Every soldier k new one when they saw it,  it was shape ingrained in the minds of all Balizians. This was unusual to say the least, Hydronian helicopters often only out as far as 10 or so kilometers past the Sal-Baliz borders, never in the middle of the desert. Abd called for the soldiers to halt and set up camp. This was rather generous of him, but nobody complained. They set up a make-shift camp and put a sand-coloured cover over their heads so they wouldn't be spotted. Abd took out his radio and contacted the High command immediately.
"This is commander Abd come in,"
"We are receiving you," replied a voice from the other end
"We just spotted a Hydronian helicopter,"

The conversation continued for several minutes. Back in the control room, communications logs were being reviewed and they discovered that Hydronia had managed to listen to part of the Supreme Leader's speeches. This was bad news, very bad news. They soon realised that this meant the Hydronians would be waiting for them at Mecca.

"We are dispatching several vehicles to your position, do not move. They will arrive in the morning."

As the command had promised, around 20 armoured vehicles arrived at 5:00am in the morning. The sun had only just begun to rise. Some of the vehicles were brand new, provided by the Sal-Baliz's latest supplier. Others looked as if they hadn't been washed for 20 years. Just as the soldiers were beginning to set off for Mecca, this time in the vehicles, a rumbling sound was heard overhead. This sound was mechanical in nature, but not the sound of a Hydronian helicopter. Upon looking up, the soldiers saw a jet emblazoned with the flag on the BR.bob. This prompted the unit to get moving quickly, but just 7 minutes later, another aircraft flew across the sky, this time from Indonocaismnic. Above all the racket of aircraft, Abd's confident voice could be heard.

"It would appear the filthy Hydronians have help, but fear not! The might of Allah reigns supreme! Allahu Akbar!"
"Allahu Akbar!" the soldiers chant in unison as the engines start and begin to speed into the horizon towards Mecca...

[/spoiler]
